item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Agent 365 for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 in public preview. This lets security and IT teams view and govern SRE agents alongside other organizational agents, with each agent able to have its own Agent ID.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway is now generally available. It lets organizations centrally govern AI agents and MCP tools and enforce security and access policies at runtime.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
item.description:
Enterprises can stream GitHub Copilot agent activity into Microsoft Agent 365. This exposes audit data from GitHub Copilot clients in Microsoft’s agent control plane.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates
